data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 取材海滩的防晒武装
data.description: 海边取材，她被遮阳帽、防晒袖套、大墨镜全副武装到只剩一小截手指握着速写本；面对大海认真速写的样子与其说是度假不如说是出任务。
data.action: 戴宽檐帽与墨镜坐着，认真在速写本上描画海岸。
data.promptProse: Sagiri Izumi studies the sea with intense concentration, sketchbook held by small exposed fingertips below her long sun-jacket sleeves. Full-length trousers, broad sunhat and large sunglasses make her beach outfit thoroughly covered. The medium view includes the drawing page in front and surf lines beyond her shoulder. Daylight reflects strongly from the sea onto the hat brim, while its shade protects her face and casts a curved shadow across the upper page.
